title: The Second Query Lies
prompt:
**Scenario.** A solution answers 100 range queries. Query 1 is always right; later queries drift. Which catalog category?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Boundary off-by-one

**B)** State staleness — a structure is reused or updated across queries

**C)** Signed overflow

**D)** Direction confusion

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: First-right-then-wrong is the staleness signature: shared state mutated by earlier queries. Off-by-one would fail regardless of position; overflow only at scale.
